heading: Ahrefs Group Buy Guide
paragraphs: Ahrefs group buy is one of the most requested SEO tools because of its backlink database, keyword research, and site audit features.
Shared plans typically include Standard or Premium tiers with daily credit limits. Credits control how many reports and lookups you can run each day.
Compare monthly cost against full retail pricing, review credit limits for your workflow, and choose a provider with stable uptime and clear refund terms.
